one of the co-authors of The Miz Maze

The title page of The Miz Maze calls her Mary Susanna Lee, and CMY describes her as the author of Rosamond Fane, confirming that she was the same person as the Mary Lee who collaborated with Catherine Lee.

She may be the M.S.

Lee who contributed a story to MP (December 1887).

According to an obituary in the Athenaeum (29 August 1908), 240, she was the daughter of a doctor, and collaborated with her sisters Catherine and Frances.
